note: Each scenario exercises one skill's intent against a live Dataverse org via the Dataverse MCP server. mode: read = query/describe only; write = creates a uniquely tagged test record then cleans it up; scaffold = the skill only writes local files, so there is no live Dataverse call to make (reported as N/A live). requires = Dataverse entity sets the scenario needs; if any are absent on the connected org the agent must answer RESULT: NA.

scenarios.prompt: Using only the Dataverse MCP tools, read the top 3 accounts (name, accountid). Confirm the read succeeded.

Using only Dataverse MCP tools: create one lead named 'zzz-bskit-test bulk-edit' (subject/topic 'zzz-bskit-test'), then update its description to 'edited by bskit harness', read it back to confirm the edit, then delete it. Report what changed.
Using only Dataverse MCP tools, read up to 20 accounts and report any pairs with identical or near-identical names (potential duplicates). Reading only, make no changes.
Using only Dataverse MCP tools, describe the account table: list a few of its columns with types. Do not modify metadata.

Using only Dataverse MCP tools, read one case (incident) and its contact and draft a customer reply. Read only; do not send or save anything to Dataverse.
